column1: # Conversions this tree performs with no cvt instruction, for
# cvtroll.awk -v magic=. A magic-number add rounds a float to an
# integer and the integer is read out of the mantissa, so an
# instruction count scores the conversion 0 while a machine with no FPU
# pays a full soft-float add for it (q8_round's own header: 48 ARM
# Found by grepping the magic constant 12582912.0f (1.5*2^23): three
# sites, one of them q8_round itself.
